description: Find FCC-licensed transmitter sites within a radius of a coordinate, nearest first, each with its callsign, licensee, distance, coordinates, location type, ground elevation, structure height, and the frequencies authorized there. Filter by frequency or band, radio service, location type, and live status (active by default). Coordinates are decimal degrees or DMS strings. Mobile and temporary-fixed operating areas are filed as a center and a radius of operation: they are returned at their center with radiusKm, and match when the center lies within radius_km. Locations filed without coordinates are not returned, and market-area licenses without site records are found with fcc_spectrum_search_frequencies.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of the same search; omit for the first page.

frequency_high.description: Band upper edge in unit; requires frequency_low.

frequency_low.description: Only sites authorized on this frequency, in unit; with frequency_high, the band's lower edge. Matches any assignment whose occupied band overlaps.

latitude.description: Search center latitude: decimal degrees (47.6205, "47.6205") or a DMS string with hemisphere ("47-37-13.8 N", "47°37'13.8"N").

location_type.description: One ULS location type code, case-insensitive: "F" keeps fixed sites only, "M" mobile and "T" temporary-fixed operating areas; see fcc_spectrum_list_reference topic "location_types". Omit for every type.

longitude.description: Search center longitude: decimal degrees (-122.3493) or a DMS string with hemisphere ("122-20-57.5 W").

max_frequencies_per_site.description: Most frequencies listed per site (1–50); frequencyCount carries the full count.

radio_service.description: Two-character radio service code, e.g. "IG" (industrial/business pool); see fcc_spectrum_list_reference topic "radio_services".

status.description: A active (default), L pending legal, X term pending, or "any" for all three. Other statuses keep no site records.

unit.description: Unit of the frequencies: kHz, MHz (default), or GHz.

name: fcc_spectrum_find_transmitters

appliedFilters.description: Filters as the server applied them, normalized values and defaults included.

frequency_high_mhz.description: Band upper edge, converted to MHz.

frequency_low_mhz.description: Band lower edge, converted to MHz.

dataAsOf.description: Creation time of the newest applied ULS file (ISO 8601).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `index_not_ready`: No completed index generation is published yet. `invalid_frequency_range`: frequency_high is below frequency_low, is given without frequency_low, or the band exceeds 300 GHz. `unknown_radio_service`: The radio service code is neither in the FCC code table nor held by the index. `service_not_indexed`: The radio service code is valid but no indexed service group carries it. `invalid_cursor`: The cursor does not decode or belongs to an earlier index generation. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor with the same inputs for the next page; absent on the last page.

notice.description: Why nothing matched and how to widen the search, or how to page further.

searchCenter.description: The search circle as the server applied it (DMS input converted).

asrNumber.description: FCC Antenna Structure Registration number: seven digits, never the 9999999 placeholder; omitted when the filing holds anything else (the placeholder, N/A, an application file number).

callsign.description: Callsign, or lease ID on a lease.

distanceKm.description: Great-circle distance from the search center to latitude/longitude, km; for an operating area (radiusKm filed) that is its center, so the area can reach nearer.

items.description: One frequency authorized at the site, collapsed across antennas and modulation steps.

bandwidthMhz.description: Widest necessary bandwidth parsed from the emission designators, MHz; a designator 20% of the assigned frequency or wider is a filing error and is left out.

emissions.description: Distinct emission designators filed for this frequency.

maxEirpDbm.description: Highest effective isotropic radiated power filed, dBm.

maxErpW.description: Highest effective radiated power filed, watts.

stationClasses.description: Distinct station classes filed for this frequency across antennas and modulation steps.

upperMhz.description: Upper edge when the assignment is a range, MHz.

frequencyCount.description: Frequencies at the site (only those overlapping the band when one is given).

groundElevationM.description: Ground elevation, meters above mean sea level.

isLease.description: True for a spectrum leasing arrangement.

latitude.description: Latitude as filed, decimal degrees (NAD83): the site, or the center of an operating area.

licenseStatus.description: License status code (A, L, or X).

licenseeName.description: Licensee (lessee on a lease) as filed; null when redacted or not on file.

licenseeRedacted.description: True when the licensee is an individual whose name is withheld.

locationNumber.description: Location number within the license; pass it as location_number to fcc_spectrum_get_license to read the location's antennas and frequencies.

locationTypeCode.description: ULS location type code, e.g. F (fixed), M (mobile), T (temporary fixed); absent when not filed.

locationTypeLabel.description: Label of the location type code, e.g. "Mobile"; absent when no type is filed.

longitude.description: Longitude as filed, decimal degrees (NAD83): the site, or the center of an operating area.

radioServiceLabel.description: Label of the radio service code.

radiusKm.description: Radius of operation around latitude/longitude, km, as filed; mobile (M) and temporary-fixed (T) areas file one, and some fixed and other sites do. Absent when not filed.

sitesSharingNumber.description: Sites the license files under this location number, when more than one; each is returned as its own site, and frequencies then lists the number's frequencies, since ULS does not say which site uses each.

state.description: Site state: as filed, or derived from the coordinates.

stateFromCoordinates.description: True when state was derived from the coordinates rather than filed.

usi.description: Unique system identifier of the license; pass it to fcc_spectrum_get_license.

totalCount.description: Sites within the radius matching the filters, across every page.

truncated.description: True when more sites follow this page.

title: Find FCC-licensed transmitters near a point
